faq.a: Every one of the 14 versions of DeepSeek in the OpenRouter catalog publishes open weights. The family's repositories on Hugging Face declare the MIT and Apache 2.0 licences, and some carry a custom licence set out on the model card.

Through the OpenRouter catalog, DeepSeek costs from free to $0.7 per million input tokens and from $0.41 to $2.5 per million output tokens, depending on the version. The cheapest is DeepSeek V4 Pro 0423.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is the newest version in the OpenRouter catalog, added on 2026-09-10.
faq.q: What is the newest DeepSeek model?

faq.a: DeepSeek versions accept image and text as input and produce text. 12 of the 14 versions support reasoning, and context windows run from 64,000 to 1,048,576 tokens.
DeepSeek is developed by DeepSeek AI. DeepSeek AI is a research lab founded in 2023 and headquartered in Hangzhou.
In the OpenRouter catalog, 40 providers serve it.

price_limits.summary: Across the 14 versions, input prices run from free to $0.7 per million tokens and output prices from $0.41 to $2.5. DeepSeek V4 Pro 0423 is the cheapest, at $0.21 per million input tokens and $0.42 per million output tokens. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has the largest context window, 1,048,576 tokens.

family_reading.text: DeepSeek is a text output family that also accepts image and text input, and all 14 listed versions publish open weights, so self hosting and inspection are possible across the line. Context windows run from 64000 to 1048576 tokens, and 12 of the 14 versions support reasoning. The spread of versions matters when choosing: the newest entries carry the largest windows and outputs, while older ones are smaller. Price varies widely, with input from $0.02 to $0.7 per million tokens and output from $0.06 to $4.2, so long outputs on the pricier tiers are the main cost risk. The facts suggest the family suits long context work, reasoning tasks and image plus text input, with cheap high volume options available. Limits are the text only output, the older small windows, and the higher output prices on some tiers.
